title: Correct performance knowledge guidance
summary: Multiple performance knowledge articles were refined to correct semantic guidance on partial records, transactions, N+1 queries, SIFT indexes, bulk writes, and read isolation, with unsafe examples replaced and two overly broad rules removed.

Narrowed guidance on singletons, TextBuilder, dictionaries, and temporary tables
Preserved behavior consistency between paired good and bad examples
Replaced unsafe Sales Header deletion scenario with staging-table approach
